summary_1line: Bhishma recounts his prolonged duel with Parashurama, featuring intense arrow exchanges and celestial weapons, with both warriors alternately wounding and reviving in battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma’s arrow strikes Parashurama, who stands drenched in blood like Mount Sumeru streaked with molten metal.
Bhishma collapses unconscious on his chariot after being pierced in the chest by Parashurama’s blazing shaft.
Parashurama falls to the ground after Bhishma fires a radiant arrow said to carry Death itself at its tip.
